text:
zoe: Deploybot is reporting an increase in semantic-accuracy regressions (BLEU-ish proxy) after the v7.3.0 rollout to hosted-api at 14:07. Deploybot recommends rollback due to quality drop on a small but important customer cohort. Thoughts on automated vs manual?

deploybot: Auto-revert suggestion: shift routing for cohort "custA-slice" back to v7.2.6. Confidence 0.77. Signals: quality-drop +13% (cohort A), overall request success unchanged. Auto-action disabled for quality regressions >10%.

omar: oncall. I want manual control here since this is quality-sensitive and might be false positive from a skewed eval set. Recommend staged 25/50/100 for the cohort slice and immediate pin for 30m if we see improvement.

nina: agree with omar. If we roll back, hold release-notes update and add a short internal note: "temporary safety pin due to cohort quality regression". Also loop legal if customers might see semantic differences.

legal: noted. If we notify customers we should avoid technical model versioning language; suggest wording: "We're routing a subset of traffic to a prior model version while we investigate differences in output quality for a specific customer cohort."

zoe: planned command (cohort slice):
```
redwoodctl traffic split --env prod --cohort custA-slice --from v7.3.0 --to v7.2.6 --pct-start 25 --pct-final 100 --step-interval 2m --reason "cohort quality regression"
```

oman: typo in my head, kicking job now (confirming operators).

deploybot: Job jb-77102 created. Awaiting operator confirm.

omar: confirming job jb-77102. Starting step1 (25%). Monitoring eval hooks and sample differs.

deploybot: step1 complete. Cohort diff metric improved from +13% -> +6%. Sample checks show fewer hallucinations.

omar: proceeding to 100% early given positive signal.

deploybot: Shift complete: 100% cohort -> v7.2.6. Cohort quality metric back to baseline.

nina: applying pin: `redwoodctl pin --env prod --cohort custA-slice --version v7.2.6 --ttl 30m --reason "safety pin after quality rollback"`. Disabling auto-rollforward and scheduled canaries for this cohort.

zoe: opening ticket INF-7007 for RCA and eval set audit. Assigning: omar (triage), nina (comm & release notes), zoe (eval audit).

legal: reviewed customer blurb draft; approve neutral wording.

ops-bot: Incident stub posted to #statuspage; queued customer template "cohort-quality-rollback" prepared.

omar: next steps: 1) confirm staging repro with curated prompts 2) check tokenization/beam differences between v7.2.6 and v7.3.0 3) run a controlled canary with narrower prompt set + logging.

nina: will withhold release notes update until INF-7007 has initial findings; will add "Note: temporary safety pin applied" to next internal changelog.

zoe: closing execution thread for now. Reopen if cohort metric drifts within pin window. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
